usageNotes: Returns per-interface network counters (bytes in/out, packets, errors, drops) for all tap and VM network devices currently active on the node. The node must be online and reachable; results reflect kernel-level counters at the moment of the call and are not persisted. Use this for a live point-in-time traffic snapshot — for historical metrics, use the RRD-based network history endpoints instead.

examples.summary: Fetch live network counters for all VM/CT interfaces on node pve1

tips: Counters are cumulative since the interface was last created or the kernel counter wrapped; subtract two readings over time to get a rate.
Only tap/veth interfaces attached to running VMs and containers appear — stopped guests produce no entries.
Counter wrap (32-bit on older kernels) can cause apparent negative deltas; handle defensively when computing rates.
For per-VM bandwidth accounting, correlate the interface name (e.g. tap101i0) back to the VMID using the guest config.
